```{r}
games_raw <- read_csv("~/Downloads/archive/csv/game.csv")
```
```{r}
season_dates <- tibble(
  actual_season = c("14_15", "15_16", "16_17", "17_18", "18_19"),
  season_start = as.Date(c(
    "2014-10-28",
    "2015-10-27",
    "2016-10-25",
    "2017-10-17",
    "2018-10-16"
  )),
  season_end = as.Date(c(
    "2015-04-15",
    "2016-04-13",
    "2017-04-12",
    "2018-04-11",
    "2019-04-10"
  ))
)

games_raw <- games_raw %>%
  mutate(
    game_date = as.Date(game_date)
  )

games_with_season <- games_raw %>%
  left_join(
    season_dates,
    by = join_by(game_date >= season_start, game_date <= season_end)
  )

keep_seasons <- c("14_15", "15_16", "16_17", "17_18")

games_filtered <- games_with_season %>%
  filter(
    actual_season %in% keep_seasons,
    season_type == "Regular Season"
  )
```

```{r}
home_games <- games_filtered %>%
  transmute(
    game_id,
    game_date,
    actual_season,
    season_type,
    
    team_id = team_id_home,
    team_abbreviation = team_abbreviation_home,
    team_name = team_name_home,
    
    opponent_id = team_id_away,
    opponent_abbreviation = team_abbreviation_away,
    opponent_name = team_name_away,
    
    home = 1,
    win = if_else(pts_home > pts_away, 1, 0),
    
    team_score = pts_home,
    opp_score = pts_away,
    
    fgm = fgm_home,
    fga = fga_home,
    fg_pct = fg_pct_home,
    fg3m = fg3m_home,
    fg3a = fg3a_home,
    fg3_pct = fg3_pct_home,
    ftm = ftm_home,
    fta = fta_home,
    ft_pct = ft_pct_home,
    oreb = oreb_home,
    dreb = dreb_home,
    reb = reb_home,
    ast = ast_home,
    stl = stl_home,
    blk = blk_home,
    tov = tov_home,
    pf = pf_home,
    plus_minus = plus_minus_home
  )
```

```{r}
team_game_data <- bind_rows(home_games, away_games) %>%
  arrange(team_id, actual_season, game_date, game_id)
```

```{r}
team_game_data <- team_game_data %>%
  group_by(team_id, actual_season) %>%
  arrange(game_date, game_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    days_since_last = as.numeric(game_date - lag(game_date)),
    b2b = if_else(!is.na(days_since_last) & days_since_last == 1, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
nba_raw <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Bayesian Analysis/new_team_game_data_2016_2018.csv")
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rethinking)
```

```{r}
nba_raw <- nba_raw %>%
  mutate(
    game_date = as.Date(game_date)
  )

nba_clean <- nba_raw %>%
  mutate(
    nba_season = case_when(
      game_date >= as.Date("2014-10-28") & game_date <= as.Date("2015-04-15") ~ "14_15",
      game_date >= as.Date("2015-10-27") & game_date <= as.Date("2016-04-13") ~ "15_16",
      game_date >= as.Date("2016-10-25") & game_date <= as.Date("2017-04-12") ~ "16_17",
      game_date >= as.Date("2017-10-17") & game_date <= as.Date("2018-04-11") ~ "17_18",
      game_date >= as.Date("2018-10-16") & game_date <= as.Date("2019-04-10") ~ "18_19",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    nba_season %in% c("14_15", "15_16", "16_17","17_18", "18_19"),
    season_type == "Regular Season"
  )

```

```{r}
nba_clean %>%
  count(nba_season)

nba_clean %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_games = n_distinct(game_id),
    n_teams = n_distinct(team_id),
    home_win_rate = mean(win[home == 1]),
    away_win_rate = mean(win[home == 0]),
    b2b_rate = mean(b2b)
  )
```

```{r}
nba_clean <- nba_clean %>%
  select(
    game_id,
    game_date,
    nba_season,
    team_id,
    team_abbreviation,
    team_name,
    opponent_id,
    opponent_abbreviation,
    opponent_name,
    home,
    win,
    b2b,
    team_score,
    opp_score,
    tov,
    ft_pct
  ) %>%
  drop_na(win, home, b2b, team_id, opponent_id)
```

```{r}
team_key <- nba_clean %>%
  select(team_id, team_abbreviation, team_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(team_id) %>%
  mutate(team_index = row_number())

nba_model <- nba_clean %>%
  left_join(
    team_key %>% select(team_id, team_index),
    by = "team_id"
  ) %>%
  rename(team = team_index) %>%
  left_join(
    team_key %>% select(team_id, team_index),
    by = c("opponent_id" = "team_id")
  ) %>%
  rename(opponent = team_index) %>%
  mutate(
    tov_z = as.numeric(scale(tov)),
    ft_pct_z = as.numeric(scale(ft_pct))
  )

N_team <- n_distinct(nba_model$team)
```

```{r}
dat <- list(
  N = nrow(nba_model),
  win = nba_model$win,
  home = nba_model$home,
  b2b = nba_model$b2b,
  team = nba_model$team,
  opponent = nba_model$opponent,
  N_team = N_team,
  tov_z = nba_model$tov_z,
  ft_pct_z = nba_model$ft_pct_z
)
```

```{r}
m4 <- ulam(
  alist(
    win ~ dbinom(1, p),
    logit(p) <- a +
      strength[team] -
      strength[opponent] +
      (b_home + u_home[team]) * home +
      b_b2b * b2b,

    strength[team] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_strength),
    u_home[team] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_home),

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1.5),
    b_home ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_b2b ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma_strength ~ dexp(1),
    sigma_home ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = dat,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
warmup = 2000,
  log_lik = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
summary_m4 <- precis(m4, depth = 2)
```


```{r}
summary_m4_df <- as.data.frame(summary_m4) %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter")

write_csv(summary_m4_df, "summary_m4_all_parameters.csv")

saveRDS(summary_m4_df, "summary_m4_all_parameters.rds")
```

```{r}
rm(m4)

rm(post_m4, team_home_effect_m4)

rm(summary_m4)

gc()
```



```{r}
m3 <- ulam(
  alist(
    win ~ dbinom(1, p),
    logit(p) <- a_team[team] + b_home * home + b_b2b * b2b,

    a_team[team] ~ dnorm(a_bar, sigma_a),

    a_bar ~ dnorm(0, 1.5),
    sigma_a ~ dexp(1),

    b_home ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_b2b ~ dnorm(0, 1)
  ),
  data = dat,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  log_lik = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
summary_m3 <- precis(m3, depth = 2)

```

```{r}
m3_csv <- summary_m3 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(model = "Model 3: Team intercepts") %>%
  select(model, parameter, mean, sd, `5.5%`, `94.5%`, rhat, ess_bulk)

write_csv(m3_csv, "m3_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
rm(list = intersect(
  c("m3", "summary_m3", "m3_csv"),
  ls()
))

gc()
```

)

```{r}


nba_model7 <- nba_model %>%
  drop_na(win, home, b2b, team, tov, ft_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    tov_z = as.numeric(scale(tov)),
    ft_pct_z = as.numeric(scale(ft_pct))
  )

dat7 <- list(
  N = nrow(nba_model7),
  win = nba_model7$win,
  home = nba_model7$home,
  b2b = nba_model7$b2b,
  team = nba_model7$team,
  N_team = max(nba_model7$team),
  tov_z = nba_model7$tov_z,
  ft_pct_z = nba_model7$ft_pct_z
)

m7 <- ulam(
  alist(
    win ~ dbinom(1, p),

    logit(p) <- a +
      (b_home + u_team[team]) * home +
      b_b2b * b2b +
      b_tov * tov_z +
      b_ft * ft_pct_z,

    u_team[team] ~ dnorm(0, sigma_u),

    a ~ dnorm(0, 1.5),
    b_home ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_b2b ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_tov ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    b_ft ~ dnorm(0, 1),

    sigma_u ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = dat7,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  log_lik = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
summary_m7 <- precis(m7, depth = 2)
```

```{r}
m7_csv <- summary_m7 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(model = "Model 7: Exploratory full model") %>%
  select(model, parameter, mean, sd, `5.5%`, `94.5%`, rhat, ess_bulk)

write_csv(m7_csv, "m7_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
rm(list = intersect(

))

gc()
```

```{r}
w_m3 <- readRDS("waic_m3.rds")
w_m4 <- readRDS("waic_m4.rds")
w_m7 <- readRDS("waic_m7.rds")

waic_table <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Model 3: Team intercepts",
    "Model 4: Strength + team home",
    "Model 7: Exploratory full model"
  ),
  WAIC = c(w_m3$WAIC, w_m4$WAIC, w_m7$WAIC),
  lppd = c(w_m3$lppd, w_m4$lppd, w_m7$lppd),
  penalty = c(w_m3$penalty, w_m4$penalty, w_m7$penalty),
  std_err = c(w_m3$std_err, w_m4$std_err, w_m7$std_err)
) %>%
  arrange(WAIC) %>%
  mutate(
    dWAIC = WAIC - min(WAIC),
    WAIC_per_obs = WAIC / nrow(nba_model)
  )

waic_table

write_csv(waic_table, "waic_table.csv")
```
